card.name: Small linking words before treatment changes
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, with, and, comma) right after a noun like treatment, given, or safety in label warnings. Most often "given to" before a change of therapy.

modes.label: Given to
modes.description: The word "to" after "Consideration should be given" in the suicidality warning, before changing the regimen.
modes.example: Consideration should be given<< to>> changing the therapeutic regimen, including possibly discontin

modes.label: Treatment with
modes.description: The word "with" after "treatment" in self-treatment advice, before prescription or over the counter medication.
modes.example: For many of the conditions discussed, treatment<< with>> prescription or over the counter medication is also

modes.label: Safety and
modes.description: The word "and" after "safety" in a statement about safety and effectiveness.
modes.example: The safety<< and>> effectiveness of epidural administration of cortic

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the text (code terms and Chinese words).
card.plain: It marks a small linking word in label text just before a treatment or therapy phrase.
